**My name is Rebecca (Becca) Prezgay, and I am a graduate student in the [Bonisoli-Alquati Lab](https://www.bonisolialquatilab.com/people.html) at Cal Poly Pomona studying pesticide accumulation in the sea urchins of fisheries and aquaculture relevance in southern California.**

My research interests include marine ecotoxicology, behavioral ecology, and anthropocentric impacts on marine ecosystems research. I have a range of experiences in education and research, primarily along the southern California coastline. I am involved with SETAC (Society of Environmental Toxicology and Chemistry) as a student representative on their board for the southern California chapter. I am also involved with SETAC's NASAC (North America Student Advisory Council).

**Education**
